fieldValues.title: Execute each ruling in every layer it names
fieldValues.move: When a ruling is ratified, file one tracked issue per layer it changes (spec, schema, Rust, each client) and keep the ruling open until each is merged or explicitly waived.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Rulings that are themselves wrong; deciding which rulings to make.
fieldValues.falsifier: A ratified ruling older than 30 days with a named layer that has neither a merged change nor an open tracked issue.
fieldValues.return_when: At the next archaeology pass, or when a ruling is found executed in only some layers.
